p_ch1: Built an XGBoost churn classifier in R for classification and classical ML using tidymodels, performing two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE preprocessing, and MCC evaluation.
p_ia1: Designed preprocessing and clustering pipelines using K-Means, HAC, DBSCAN on BoW, TF-IDF, Skip-gram, and SBERT embeddings, tracing silhouette scores below 0.30 to repeated template vocabulary.
p_bt1: Built an LSTM forecaster with cyclic date encoding and time-series cross-validated grid search, deploying it via TensorFlow Serving REST API for model serving.
